morgan_partners: Kickoff: VaultLink marketplace + secrets integration. Scope: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, BYOK KMS handoff. Need owners and deliverables.
taylor_eng: I'll take SAML + SCIM implementation and tests. What SCIM attributes do we need? email, userName, groups?
jamie_pm: I'll own marketplace listing + docs. Need final screenshots and a 1-sentence blurb.
sam_security: Security asks: HSM attestation for BYOK, rotation policy, audit retention (12 months), and no plaintext keys in telemetry.
pat_sre: I'll draft BYOK onboarding runbook including cert-exchange example and a terraform snippet. Also propose a fallback to Redwood-managed keys with opt-in.
ravi_sales: Sales needs a short GTM line referencing SSO + SCIM + BYOK compliance. Sending draft soon.
ops-bot: created INT-5012 https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INT-5012 (owner: morgan_partners)
taylor_eng: SCIM test curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X GET "https://scim.vaultlink.example.com/Users"
```
taylor_eng: SAML ACS example: `<AssertionConsumerService Location="https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs"/>`
sam_security: I'll upload an attestation template and required fields by EOD.
morgan_partners: Owners: Taylor=SAML/SCIM, Pat=BYOK runbook, Sam=security signoff, Jamie=marketplace. Sync tomorrow 11am PT. Please add assets to the shared drive and tag me. :thumbsup:
